status: Prospective-to-new-file-labels local pilot plan; not registered and not a field trial
source: Official SIPP 2024 (reference 2023) and SIPP 2025 (reference 2024), after documented 2023-and-earlier education allocation issue
record: December reference-month record only; unique SPANEL/SSUID/PNUM
prior_frame: 2024 December rows, baseline age TAGE_EHC>=25, positive WPFINWGT, panels 2022/2023/2024 (scheduled to continue in 2025)
cluster: SPANEL + SSUID + prior SHHADID (household at prior interview), fixed before later-wave matching
linkage: SPANEL/SSUID/PNUM, with SWAVE increment exactly 1; audit nonmatches and new persons, never match by names
group_definition: Native if EBORNUS=1 or ENATCIT in {4,5}; foreign if EBORNUS=2 and [ECITIZEN=2 or ENATCIT in {1,2,3}]. Other combinations are missing, never forced to either group. Audit coding comparability with ACS.
binary_outcome: EEDUC>=43 among valid codes31..46; retain AEDUC flags; reported-only sensitivity requires AEDUC=1 in both waves
field_gates: Complete prior roster does not imply current roster or current person weights
Prior-wave groups/weights/age/sex/education only as predictive/design inputs
Report planned panel rotation separately from unscheduled nonobservation
Separate households with members lost/new from retrospective fully matched clusters
Public EEDUC label is not independently verified qualification; investigate feed-forward
audit_metrics: Eligible historical adults/clusters and nativity cells
Education and BA+ transitions, including reversals

conditional_pilot.gate: At least1000 fully linked baseline clusters; all12 demographic cells positive; otherwise no simulation
conditional_pilot.target: Only the retrospective fully observed baseline clusters; no claim this subset was knowable preselection or representative of residents
conditional_pilot.fixed_weights: Prior 2024 WPFINWGT; no current or longitudinal calibrated weights presented as known in advance
conditional_pilot.standardization: Equal-nativity average of the prior weighted six age/sex compositions, fixed before 2025 education parsing
conditional_pilot.risk: Preselection household sum of squared target coefficients times prior-cell Bernoulli variance; eight background strata, up to4 within-stratum risk bins; integer Neyman allocation
metrics: unresolved and wrong/correct report fractions at1/2/5pp
conditional_pilot.contrast: Prior BA carry-forward vs prior-cell and direct controls; allocation vs SRS with same prior-BA predictor. No best-method selection from target outcomes
conditional_pilot.sensitivity: Reported-only (both AEDUC=1) changes target subset; disclose sample selection and do not call it ground truth

not_a_solution: Failure of historical-to-current roster coverage remains a deployment limitation even if conditional pilot precision improves. Attrition and field costs are not solved by resampling retained cases.
